# brewpage-openapi

Single source of truth for the BrewPage REST API contract and the BrewPage MCP server.

## What's here

- `openapi/openapi.yaml` — hand-written OpenAPI 3.1 spec. Currently `info.version: 1.31.0`.
- `openapi/openapi.json` — same spec, regenerated via `npx js-yaml`.
- `mcp-server/` — TypeScript implementation of the BrewPage MCP server. Currently `version: 1.4.0`. Published as `brewpage-mcp` on npm.
- `docs/` — Astro docs site published at https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/.

## Where to read the live API

- Spec (browser-rendered): https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/api-reference/
- Spec (raw YAML): https://kochetkov-ma.github.io/brewpage-openapi/openapi.yaml
- Live `/v3/api-docs` from production backend: https://brewpage.app/v3/api-docs
- `llms.txt`: https://brewpage.app/llms.txt
- `llms-full.txt`: https://brewpage.app/llms-full.txt

## Recent contract changes

- 1.31.0 (matches backend v1.41.0): `POST /api/html` and `PUT /api/html/{ns}/{id}` accept raw `text/*` and (POST only) `application/octet-stream` bodies. Binary payloads route to `/api/files`. New 422 response with `supportedTypes` array; 415 enriched. See `https://brewpage.app/llms-full.txt`.

## How to use the MCP server

```bash
npx -y brewpage-mcp@latest
```

Or pin a version: `npx -y brewpage-mcp@1.4.0`.

The server exposes the same operations the OpenAPI spec describes — read `mcp-server/README.md` for tool list and usage.
